text:
maria.g: anyone else see weird org attribution in rollout metrics? saw tag-affinity=canary showing up under multiple tenant IDs in the dashboard :eyes:
ajay.k: that sounds bad. can you paste the query / sample traces?
maria.g: dug into the telemetry stream, looks like the rollout tag gets stamped by the edge proxy and not stripped before internal metrics enrichment. quick example log snippet:
```
2026-03-19T14:02:11Z INFO router request_id=abc123 x-affinity=canary org_id=org_42 route=/console/ui/metrics
2026-03-19T14:02:11Z INFO metrics_enricher request_id=abc123 org_id=org_99 tags=[x-affinity=canary]
```
sara: ugh, so router attaches tag, but downstream service is re-associating org_id to the local request context and preserving the header as a tag. that would explain cross-org spikes.
kevin: is this limited to telemetry or does it affect quota/accounting pipes too?
maria.g: initial look — telemetry and dashboards only. quota checks use auth token->org lookup and ignore headers, but the UX shows the wrong rollout group in per-tenant dashboards which is confusing for customers.
elaine.t: could be our header sanitizer in the internal gateway isn't whitelisting properly after the rollout for header-based routing. iirc we only strip `x-affinity` on public edge, not on internal sidecars.
ajay.k: assign to eng-oncall to triage, please. what timeframe?
maria.g: low friction mitigation: stop echoing `x-affinity` into metrics tags in the metrics_enricher until we audit. patch would be 1 line in enrich pipeline. i can PR.
kevin: +1 for quick mitigation. but we should also add a fix in the gateway so headers aren't forwarded to services that then attach them as tags. defense in depth.
sara: agree. also add a test in the telemetry regression suite: simulate request with mismatched org header and ensure tags derive only from auth lookup.
deply-bot: deploy queued: telemetry-enricher/patch-222 -> staging (sha: f2c1d3)
deploy-bot: if staging tests green, promote to prod after 30m.
maria.g: tagging @ajay.k @kevin for design review on gateway changes. also flag this as a user-facing telemetry regression for SRE/CS so they can explain to affected customers.
ajay.k: i'll take gateway change. will propose a small header-sanitizer middleware that runs before header->tag mapping. plan: (1) quick enricher patch to stop header tagging, (2) middleware in gateway to strip `x-affinity` unless request from our edge, (3) add unit+integration tests. timeline: patch in next 2 hours, gateway design PR EOD.
kevin: add a short note to incidents channel and mark dashboards as potentially flaky for the last 4 hours. ops should mute alerts tied to rollout tags.
oncall: oncall assigned: elaine.t. investigating.
maria.g: thanks all — i'll open the enricher PR now and link here. once mitigated we should backfill corrected telemetry for last 6 hours if possible (metrics pipeline supports re-ingest).
elaine.t: confirmed noisy dashboards suppressed. continuing triage.
maria.g: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/telemetry-enricher/pulls/462 (mitigation)
ajay.k: gateway sanitizer PR drafted: https://git.internal/redwood/gateway/pulls/289
kevin: nice. followup ticket to validate no quota/accounting fallout: RD-#4821.
sara: recording retrospective action: ensure header->tag mapping must always validate org_id via authn service.
maria.g: end state: telemetry tags only from trusted sources. thanks :thumbsup:
